candidate.name: intraday_range_clock_variance_240m
candidate.mechanism: Second central clock moment of the complete stock-day normalized intrabar log-range distribution.
candidate.formula: q_i=log(high_i/low_i), p_i=q_i/sum(q), u_i=i/239, mu=sum(p_i*u_i), factor=4*sum(p_i*(u_i-mu)^2) for i=0,...,239.
candidate.exact_support_predicate: The raw stock-day has the exact immutable 241-row identity; all 240 selected high/low pairs are finite, strictly positive, and ordered low<=high; every q_i is finite and nonnegative; sum(q_i) is finite and strictly positive; the factor is finite and inside [0,1] after only 1e-12 endpoint canonicalization.
candidate.zero_semantics: A zero-range bar contributes exact zero mass at its fixed clock. A stock-day remains eligible with any positive count from one through 240. No zero removal, bridge, epsilon, support repair, pair minimum, peer minimum, or imputation is allowed.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_range_clock_center_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: Both are moments of the same normalized range-clock distribution.
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: The terminal factor is the first moment mu and changes under clock translation. Campaign098 is the centered second moment and is unchanged by translations that remain inside the grid; distributions with equal centers can have different variance.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_amount_clock_dispersion_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: Both use a normalized second clock moment.
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: The terminal factor allocates transaction amount; Campaign098 allocates log high-low uncertainty and is invariant to every amount or volume change.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_intrabar_range_participation_entropy_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: Both summarize the complete normalized range-mass distribution.
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Entropy is invariant to clock permutation and measures probability evenness; Campaign098 depends on numeric clock distances and measures temporal separation. Equal entropy can have arbitrarily different clock variance.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_range_local_peak_clock_dispersion_236p
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: Both concern dispersion of range activity over clock time.
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: The terminal factor retains only strict local peaks and requires a peak topology. Campaign098 weights every fixed bar by its exact range mass, has no peak classification, and remains defined with one positive-range bar.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_morning_afternoon_range_profile_similarity_120b
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: Both use the timing shape of intrabar ranges.
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: The terminal factor compares paired half-session profiles; Campaign098 has no half partition or paired clock and uses absolute full-session distances from its own center.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_range_amount_profile_alignment_js_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: Both contain a normalized range profile.
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: The terminal factor compares range with amount via Jensen-Shannon similarity. Campaign098 reads no amount and is an own-range temporal moment.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_market_range_profile_synchronization_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: Both use the full normalized range profile.
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Campaign097 is a contemporaneous leave-one-out peer correlation. Campaign098 is peer invariant and depends only on the stock's own central clock moment.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: candidate49_intraday_cumulative_vwap_crossing_rate_240m_v1
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: Both are known after the completed signal session.
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Candidate49 uses close, amount, volume, causal cumulative VWAP, and a prospective ledger. Campaign098 is historical-only high/low range dispersion and never touches Candidate49 artifacts.
